title: Responsibility
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names chores and says why a responsible child does them without expecting reward, as for the Lord (Colossians 3:23).

floor.prerequisite: Knows how children help parents at home.
floor.question: Name a way you help your parents.

steps: Name chores you do at home.
Say why we do them without pay.

board.do: Write Colossians 3:23: work as for the Lord.

board.say: Why do we help without asking for a reward?

board.do: Wait for the child to say we love our family, God sees.

misconceptions.ask: Mother asks you to sweep the house. Should you ask for money first?
misconceptions.repair: Read Colossians 3:23. Talk about what parents do for children without pay.

misconceptions.ask: Can a boy wash utensils at home?
misconceptions.repair: List chores and ask who can do each: everyone.

misconceptions.ask: A classmate is writing on the wall. What is a responsible thing to do?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play kind words: "Please stop, that is wrong." Then tell a teacher.

misconceptions.ask: Your parent is away. Should you still do your chores?

checks.question: Name a chore you do at home.
Should a child ask for money before helping at home?
